Salaried logo ke liye EPFO se aayi badi khushkhabri! 💸

Ab emergency mein PF ka zyada paisa nikalna aasan ho gaya hai:

👉 Minimum balance limit 25% se ghata kar 10% kar di gayi hai.
👉 Account holders ab apne PF se 90% tak paisa nikal sakenge.
👉 55 saal ki umr se pehle bhi 90% withdrawal ki chhoot milegi.

HR se salary badhane ki umeed chhodkar PF se hi kaam chalana padega! 😅

Apne us salaried dost ko tag karo jisko PF ke paise ki sakht zaroorat hai!
